notes:
Sales notes and negotiation log:
- Customer: quantitative trading analytics firm; latency-sensitive scoring + reranking for live order routing.
- Primary ask: Dedicated capacity with guaranteed throughput during market open (13:30-20:00 UTC). Must avoid any performance degradation during these windows.
- Proposed Redwood offer: dedicated pool of 4 GPUs (A100/80GB equiv), burst allowance to 6 GPUs for 15 minutes/hr, autoscale in 5-min increments; SLOs: 99.95% uptime, p95 latency <= 35ms for scoring endpoint, throughput guarantee 5k reqs/s sustained during reserved windows.
- Customer pushback: wants uptime 99.99% for market-open windows and a more favorable credit schedule (tiered credits starting at 5% for <99.99, 15% for <99.9). Legal flagged continuous availability clause and disaster recovery RTO.
- Credits/penalties under discussion: Redwood standard: service credits prorated monthly, 5% for 99.9-99.95, 10% for 99.5-99.9, 25% for <99.5. Tideway asked for: 10% at <99.99, 30% at <99.9. AE/SE recommend middle ground: 99.97 threshold for 10% credit, 99.5 for 25%.
- Maintenance windows: Tideway wants maintenance only outside market-open windows and a 72-hr advance notify for any rolling upgrade that might affect reserved pool. Redwood proposed regular maintenance Sundays 02:00-06:00 UTC + emergency patching with 4-hr mitigation SLA.
- Support: Customer requires 24/7 P0 (1-hr response, 4-hr resolution target), P1 (4-hr response), dedicated escalation contact during market-open. Redwood proposed 24/7 P0 response but 8-hr resolution SLA; customer rejecting. Negotiation ongoing - offered elevated support add-on with 1-hr P0 response and 8-hr resolution commitment for initial term.
- Measurement and reporting: Tideway demands monthly uptime report, token/req-level latency breakdown, and access to per-route trace logs (redacted). They also want a monthly capacity review and right to request 30-day burst increases twice/year.
- Reserved GPU planning: Tideway provided peak profile; team recommends commitment to 6 x A100-eq for market-open reserve (4 active + 2 warm), with explicit headroom for caching to reduce effective GPU use by ~18%. SE note: need to validate KV cache hit rates during POC to refine committed quantity.
- Escalations: opened INFRA-4231 for POC tail latency root cause analysis; SE Diego assigned.
- Next immediate actions: update SLA draft with revised credit bands (proposal doc in Drive), mark blackout windows in contract, scope elevated support add-on pricing, schedule legal redline review 2026-03-15.
- Quote: initial term 24 months preferred by Tideway for pricing protection.
